title: Tourists at a temple site at sunrise
author: Shyamal
caption: Tourists waiting for sunrise at Angkor Wat, Cambodia
shows: A ground-level photograph taken at dawn. In the middle, a long, dense crowd of several hundred tourists stands and sits shoulder to shoulder along the edge of a pond, many holding up cameras and phones; the crowd fills the whole width of the photograph. Behind them are tall palm trees and large shady trees. The still pond in the front half of the photograph reflects the crowd and the trees, and has water-lily leaves floating near the bottom. The temple itself is not in the picture.

title: A beach resort town from above
author: PattayaPatrol
caption: Pattaya Beach, Thailand, seen from a high building
shows: A high view along a long, curved sandy beach. On the right, the land behind the beach is packed with buildings: many high-rise hotel and apartment towers, the tallest in a cluster in the distance, with smaller buildings between them. A busy road full of cars runs right beside the beach, lined with a single row of palm trees. On the left is a calm bay with many small boats; several speedboats leave white wakes across the water, and lines of floating buoys mark off swimming areas close to the shore. A few people are spread out on the sand. Almost no natural vegetation is left behind the beach except the roadside palms and some trees between buildings.

title: A flooded city street
author: VOA Indonesian Service
caption: A street in Jakarta, Indonesia, after heavy rain in January 2013
shows: A wide city street covered by fast-moving brown, muddy floodwater that fills the whole front of the photograph. A silver car is driving through water that reaches above its wheels to the bottom of its bonnet. A red lorry with its headlights on drives through the water beside it, and people push motorcycles through the water on the left. Several people wade through water up to their knees and thighs; behind the car, a group of people holding umbrellas stands crowded on top of a vehicle above the water. Behind the street are tall trees, lamp posts, a banner across the road and the lower floors of tall city buildings. The sky is grey.

title: Haze over a city
author: Jimmy Tan
caption: A view across Singapore in 2015
shows: A view from a high floor across a city of high-rise blocks of flats, with low buildings with orange and green roofs in the front. The whole sky is a flat, pale grey-white with no blue sky and no sun visible. The nearest buildings are clear, but blocks further away become pale and blurred, and the most distant blocks are only faint outlines that fade into the grey air. There is no rain and no cloud with an edge; the greyness is spread evenly through the air.

title: Mangroves at low tide
author: Lip Kee
caption: Mangroves at Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve, Singapore, at low tide
shows: A belt of thick, low, dark-green trees with dense, rounded crowns grows along the left side and back of the photograph. In front of the trees is a wide, flat stretch of grey mud exposed by the low tide, with shallow water lying in a channel that winds between the mud and the trees. The trees grow right down to the edge of the mud, and the bottoms of their trunks are close to the mud surface. There are no buildings and no people.

title: A high-rise housing estate
author: Terence Ong
caption: Toa Payoh, a housing estate in Singapore, seen from a high block
shows: A view from high up over a housing estate of many tall blocks of flats, ten to thirty storeys high, standing close together in rows and stretching to the horizon. A wide road with trees along both sides runs from the front right into the distance. There is a grassy field with trees at the bottom right and patches of green between some blocks. Lower buildings with red-tiled roofs are at the bottom. The sky is pale blue with white clouds.

title: A cone-shaped volcano erupting
author: Jaycee Esmeria
caption: Mayon Volcano, the Philippines, erupting
shows: A tall, almost perfectly cone-shaped mountain with steep, smooth, grey-green sides that rise to a narrow pointed top. A thick cloud of grey ash billows up from near the top and rolls down the left-hand slope as a dark, lumpy cloud that reaches far down the mountainside. There is no red glow or flowing lava visible. Green forest and fields cover the flat land at the foot of the volcano in front. The sky is blue with some white clouds beside the mountain.

title: A city centre after an earthquake
author: UN Photo/Logan Abassi
caption: Port-au-Prince, Haiti, a few days after the earthquake of January 2010
shows: An aerial photograph looking down on the centre of a city. Many buildings have collapsed into flat heaps of broken concrete and rubble; in several places the floors of a building have fallen flat on top of one another, and one large sign lies on top of a collapsed building. Some buildings are still standing next to ones that have fallen. The buildings are packed closely together along narrow streets, with flat concrete roofs. Rubble spills into the streets and blocks parts of them. Small groups of people walk in the streets, and a few vehicles are parked there.

title: A coastal village after a tsunami
author: U.S. Navy (Philip A. McDaniel)
caption: A village near Banda Aceh, Sumatra, Indonesia, a week after the tsunami of 26 December 2004
shows: An aerial photograph of a flat, low-lying coastal plain with green hills behind it and the sea far in the distance. Across the plain, most houses have been destroyed: only scattered roofs and a few buildings are left standing, surrounded by wide patches of brown debris (broken wood, rubble) and large pools of standing water. Many areas where houses must have stood are now bare ground or water. A few trees still stand among the ruins. The green hills at the back look undamaged, and the land on them is higher than the plain.

title: Fold mountains seen from space
author: NASA
caption: The Himalayas photographed from the International Space Station
shows: A view from very high above, looking across a huge mountain range. The back half of the photograph is filled with many jagged, snow-covered peaks and sharp ridges packed closely together, one behind another, with deep valleys between them; a small white cloud trails from one of the highest peaks. In front, the land is lower, brown and bare, with rows of smaller ridges and a flatter, wide valley floor at the bottom right. Above the peaks, at the very top, is a flat layer of cloud.

title: A typhoon seen by a satellite
author: NASA (LAADS Web; processed by Supportstorm)
caption: Typhoon Haiyan on 7 November 2013 (satellite image)
shows: A satellite image looking straight down on the sea. A huge, round mass of thick white cloud fills most of the image and spirals around a centre, with long curved bands of cloud swirling outwards from it. In the very middle is a small, round, dark hole with no cloud: the eye. The thickest, brightest cloud forms a solid ring around the eye. Near the top left corner, the green and brown land of several islands can be seen, partly covered by cloud; the storm is out over the sea to the south-east of them. The sea between the cloud bands is dark.

title: Forest clearing seen by a satellite
author: NASA Earth Observatory (Jesse Allen and Robert Simmon)
caption: Part of the Amazon rainforest in Rondônia, Brazil, on 12 August 2007 (satellite image)
shows: A satellite image of a large area of land. Unbroken forest shows as dark green and covers the edges of the image. Across the middle, a large area has been cleared and shows as tan and light-green patches. Many of the clearings are thin straight strips set at right angles off straight lines (roads), like the bones of a fish; in the centre the strips have joined into one big cleared block. A winding river crosses the top half. Several thin, pale grey-white plumes of smoke drift across the image, especially near the top and the left edge.
